items.title: Insertion order
clues: A buyer and a seller agree campaign terms in me.
I state budget, dates and price.
items.why: The insertion order is the agreed record of a campaign.

items.title: eCPM
clues: I turn different deals into one comparable number.
I am revenue per thousand impressions.
Publishers use me to compare demand sources.
items.why: eCPM lets a publisher compare CPM, CPC and CPA deals fairly.

items.title: Sell-through rate
clues: I tell how much of the available space was sold.
Sold impressions divided by available impressions.
items.why: Sell-through is sold impressions as a share of what was available.
